genres.pop: Pop is built around catchy hooks and clean production. It usually has medium to high energy and suits parties, workouts, and everyday listening.
genres.lofi: Lofi uses slow relaxed beats, soft keys, and a warm worn sound with few vocals. It has low energy and suits studying, reading, and working.
genres.rock: Rock is driven by electric guitars and live drums. It ranges from confident to intense and has high energy, which suits driving and workouts.
genres.ambient: Ambient music uses slow evolving textures with little rhythm. It has very low energy and suits relaxing, sleeping, or deep concentration.
genres.jazz: Jazz features improvised melodies, piano, and brushed drums. It is warm and relaxed with low energy and suits cafes, dinners, and quiet evenings.
genres.synthwave: Synthwave recreates 80s electronic sounds with pulsing synths and steady rhythm. It is nostalgic and moody and suits night drives and retro vibes.
genres.indie pop: Indie pop mixes pop melodies with jangly or hazy guitars and a handmade feel. It is cheerful or dreamy with medium energy and suits sunny days.
genres.hip hop: Hip hop centers on rhythm, bass, and rapped vocals. It ranges from confident and hard to laid back and chill and suits walking, commuting, and hanging out.
genres.classical: Classical music is acoustic and orchestral or solo instrumental. It is usually quiet and emotional with low energy and suits calm moments and sleep.
genres.country: Country has acoustic guitar, storytelling lyrics, and a warm feel. It is often nostalgic or uplifting and suits road trips and relaxed evenings.
genres.edm: EDM is electronic dance music with big drops and fast tempos. It has very high energy and suits festivals, parties, and running.
genres.r&b: R&B combines smooth vocals with slow groovy rhythms. It is romantic or moody with medium energy and suits evenings and late nights.
genres.metal: Metal uses distorted guitars, fast drums, and powerful vocals. It has extreme energy and an aggressive tone and suits heavy workouts and venting.
genres.folk: Folk is acoustic and intimate, built on fingerpicked guitar and honest vocals. It is calm, peaceful, or wistful with low energy and suits quiet reflection.
genres.reggae: Reggae has an offbeat rhythm, deep bass, and a sunny feel. It is relaxed or uplifting with medium energy and suits beaches and unwinding.
genres.blues: Blues is built on emotional guitar and expressive vocals about hardship. It is slow and melancholy with low energy and suits late evenings.
genres.punk: Punk is fast, loud, and raw with short songs and shouted vocals. It has very high energy and a rebellious attitude.
genres.latin: Latin music is rhythmic with percussion and brass. It is joyful and danceable with high energy and suits dancing and celebrations.
genres.soul: Soul features warm powerful vocals over gentle grooves. It is romantic and heartfelt with medium energy and suits slow dancing and quiet nights.

moods.happy: A happy mood means upbeat, bright music with positive lyrics and a major key feel.
moods.chill: A chill mood means relaxed, low pressure music with a steady slow pulse that is easy to have in the background.
moods.intense: An intense mood means powerful, driving music with high energy that builds adrenaline.
moods.relaxed: A relaxed mood means gentle, unhurried music that helps you unwind.
moods.moody: A moody mood means dark, atmospheric music with an introspective or brooding feel.
moods.focused: A focused mood means steady, repetitive music without strong vocals that helps concentration.
moods.confident: A confident mood means bold, swaggering music with strong rhythm and attitude.
moods.peaceful: A peaceful mood means very quiet, serene music that calms the mind and suits rest.
moods.nostalgic: A nostalgic mood means warm, familiar sounding music that recalls memories of the past.
moods.euphoric: A euphoric mood means soaring, ecstatic music with huge energy and emotional release.
moods.romantic: A romantic mood means smooth, tender music with warm vocals suited to couples and slow evenings.
moods.aggressive: An aggressive mood means harsh, forceful music full of anger and raw power.
moods.melancholy: A melancholy mood means slow, wistful music with a sad but reflective feel.
moods.uplifting: An uplifting mood means hopeful, positive music that lifts your spirits.
moods.sad: A sad mood means slow emotional music about loss or heartbreak with a heavy feel.
moods.rebellious: A rebellious mood means loud, defiant music that rejects rules and expectations.
moods.joyful: A joyful mood means exuberant, danceable music that makes people celebrate.
moods.dreamy: A dreamy mood means soft, hazy music that feels like floating and drifting away.
